description.en:
_"Will you stay over at my house starting today?"_ 

Riku Kuromine, a second-year high school student, became despondent after being rejected by his childhood friend. He happens to enter a convenience store and saves a clerk who was being attacked by a robber. The clerk turns out to be Ayana Hoshimiya, the most popular and beautiful gal in school. As a result of this incident, Ayana asks Riku to protect her from a stalker and they start living together under the guise of him protecting her as she lives alone.
description.ja:
**見た目は派手ギャル、中身は超絶うぶ!? “うぶかわ”ギャル×非リア、禁断の同棲ラブコメ!!**

「今日から、あたしの家に……泊まる？」高校二年生の黒峰リクは、幼馴染に振られて自暴自棄になったところ、偶然入ったコンビニで強盗に襲われていた店員を助ける。その店員は学校でいちばんモテる美人ギャル・星宮彩奈だった。この件をきっかけに星宮からストーカー被害を相談され、一人暮らしの彼女を守る名目でふたりは同棲することになり――!?
description.pt-br:
“Você gostaria de ficar em minha casa esta noite?”
Riku Kuromine, um aluno do segundo ano do ensino médio, ficou triste depois de ser rejeitado por sua amiga de infância. Por coincidência, ele entra em uma loja de conveniência e salva uma funcionária que estava sendo roubada. A funcionária era na verdade Ayana Hoshimiya, a garota mais popular e atraente da escola. Como resultado desse incidente, Ayana pede a Riku para passar a noite em sua casa e protegê-la de um perseguidor.

A new relationship begins after a seven year reunion!

description.en:
My childhood friend Shida Kuroha seems to have feelings for me. She lives next door, and is small and cute. With an outgoing character, she’s the caring Onee-san type, this being one of her greatest strengths.  
  
…But, I already have my first love, the beautiful idol of our school, and the award-winning author high school girl, Kachi Shirokusa! Thinking about it rationally, I should have no chances with her, but, while walking home from school, she only talks to me, with a smile even! I might actually have a chance, don’t you think?!  
  
Or so I thought, but then I heard that Shirokusa already has a boyfriend, and my life took a turn for the worse. I want to die. Why is it not me?! Even though she was my first love…As I was drowning in despair and depression, Kuroha whispered.  
  
—If it’s that tough for you, then how about we get revenge? The best revenge ever, that is~

description.en:
I've never seen such a villainous lady! I won’t die in misery again! A unique comedic tragedy that will make you laugh and cry!  
  
Stabbed 7 times. Massacred 11 times. Beheaded 5 times. Hanged 3 times. Burnt to death 7 times. Drowned 8 times. Run over 3 times. Shot 12 times. Poisoned 6 times. Strangled 7 times, *etcetera*… Scarlett was a villainess whose life has repeated 108 times in total. The duke’s redheaded, red-eyed daughter summoned fear and terrorized the nation as a ruthless queen. In all of her 108 lifetimes, she always ended up dying at the age of 28. After 107 lifetimes ending by being killed by one of the five heroes and the flower-minded heroine, she died for the 108th due to an accident. Thus on her 109th life, Scarlett regains all her memories and tries to break free from the loop. Will Scarlet be able to break the chains of the Red Curse?

Alice Ryouhei will leave high school soon, but he's trying to avoid thinking about his future. Late one night, when he's hanging out with his tough friend Karube and his silly, girl-crazy friend Chota, they see fireworks. After one blindingly bright explosion, they find themselves waking up in a different world. In this 'Borderland,' people are forced to either participate in potentially deadly games or simply die. Will Chota, Karube, and Ryouhei be able to survive this dangerous new world, and is there a way they can get back to their original lives?

description.en:
Go to another world, eat delicious food, and “eat” married women while you’re at it!?

Several years have passed since the reincarnated hero defeated the Demon King, allowing the real world and the other world to interact.

Kogarashi, an Otherworld Investigator, travels to various regions to investigate the traces left behind by the hero. He is serious and completely devoted to his work… however, this man is an unparalleled foodie whose hobby is eating rare delicacies from the other world!!!

Moreover, when he consumes food from the other world, his skill causes him to release pheromones that charm the local inhabitants. Even though he just wants to eat delicious things, for some reason Kogarashi ends up charming and doing it with the married women of the other world every time. Why not enjoy a meal and get intimately close with beautiful women?

An eating tour (with a double meaning) otherworld life!!!

異世界に行って美味いもの食ってついでに人妻も食う!?

転生者の勇者が魔王を倒し、現実世界と異世界が交流ができるようになって幾年。
異世界調査官の木枯は、各地を回り、勇者の痕跡を調査していた。
真面目で仕事一筋…しかしこの男、無類のグルメ好きで異世界の珍味を食べるこを趣味にしていた!!!
しかも、異世界の食物を摂取すると、住民達を魅了するフェロモンを放出するスキルも持っているのだ。
美味いモノを食べたいだけなのに、何故か毎回異世界の人妻達を魅了してヤってしまう木枯。

美女と一緒にご飯も食べてしっぽりしませんか？ 食べ歩き（意味深）異世界ライフ!!!
description.es-la:
¿Ir a otro mundo, degustar comida deliciosa y ‘comerse’ a las esposas como aperitivo!?

Han pasado varios años desde que el héroe reencarnado derrotó al Rey Demonio, permitiendo la interacción entre el mundo moderno y el otro mundo.
Kogarashi, un Investigador de Extradimensional, viaja por diversas regiones para investigar las huellas dejadas por el héroe. Es serio y completamente entregado a su trabajo… sin embargo, este hombre es un tragón incomparable, cuyo pasatiempo es devorar rarezas culinarias del otro mundo.

Además, cuando consume alimentos de ese mundo, su habilidad provoca que libere feromonas que encantan a los habitantes locales. Aunque solo quiere comer cosas deliciosas, por alguna razón Kogarashi cada vez termina seduciendo y acostándose con las esposas de ese otro mundo. ¿Por qué no disfrutar de un buen plato y acercarse íntimamente a bellas mujeres casadas?

¡¡¡Una vida en otro mundo de turismo gastronómico (con doble sentido)!!!

description.en:
Rachel, the Duke's Daughter, was accused of crimes that she had never even heard of by the Crown Prince Elliot and imprisoned in the palace dungeon. Was this a plot hatched by one of her rivals or a conspiracy formed by political foes of her family…!?   
  
Rachel, however, only had one thing on her mind…   
  
"Hooray for prison! An endless lazy slow life! No more of that wretched royal education or those suffocating servants for me, it's time for a vacation!"   
  
Rachel, who was ready and rearing to go, will enjoy her leisure filled days harassing the Prince from her prison cell! Her liberating and pleasant (slow) life in prison is about to begin.
description.id:
Rachel, Putri Duke, dituduh melakukan kejahatan yang bahkan belum pernah dia dengar oleh Pangeran Mahkota Elliot dan dipenjara di ruang bawah tanah istana. Apakah ini rencana yang dibuat oleh salah satu saingannya atau konspirasi yang dibentuk oleh musuh politik keluarganya…!?

Namun, Rachel hanya punya satu hal di benaknya…

“Horayy dipenjara! Kehidupan lambat yang malas dan tiada akhir! Tidak ada lagi pendidikan bangsawan yang menyedihkan atau pelayan yang mencekik bagiku, sudah waktunya liburan!”

Rachel, yang sudah siap dan bersiap untuk pergi, akan menikmati hari yang diisi dengan melecehkan Pangeran dari sel penjara dia! Kehidupannya yang membebaskan dan menyenangkan (lambat) di penjara akan segera dimulai.

Rachel estava pronta e preparada para a prisão, desfrutando os seus dias de férias e atacando o Príncipe da cela da prisão. Sua vida libertadora e lenta está começando!

في عام 1294 من أربورال، يهيمن على العالم تسعة أبراج ضخمة تُعرف باسم الأبراج المدببة، وهي بقايا حضارة قديمة. مليئة بالأسرار المفقودة والمعرفة القوية، تكافح الأمم لامتلاكها. لوكاس هو عازف بوق في عصابة مرتزقة لا يريد شيئًا أكثر من ترك ساحة المعركة وراءه ليصبح موسيقيًا حقيقيًا، ومايسترو. ولكن نظرًا لكونه أحد البشر الغامضين، وموهوبًا بالقدرة الغريبة على رؤية صوت آلته الموسيقية، يجد لوكاس نفسه منجذبًا على مضض إلى حرب ذات أبعاد ملحمية!

بعد تركه ليموت بعد معركة، أنقذ الملك الغامض لوكاس ويعلم أنه ليس الشخص الوحيد الذي يتمتع بقوى غير عادية. شكل الملك فريقًا خاصًا من أفراد الراموس الذين يخطط لاستخدامهم لمساعدته في هزيمة الإمبراطوريات المنافسة، ويعلم لوكاس أن قواه، بدلاً من أن تكون هروبًا من ساحة المعركة، تجبره الآن على أن يكون مصدر إلهام للمذابح.
description.en:
In Arboral Year 1294, the world is dominated by nine massive towers known as the Spires, remnants of an ancient civilization. Filled with lost secrets and powerful knowledge, nations struggle to possess them. Luca is a bugler in a mercenary company who wants nothing more than to leave the battlefield behind and become a true musician, a maestro. But marked as one of the enigmatic Branch-hexed, and gifted with the strange ability to see the sound of his instrument, Luca finds himself drawn reluctantly into a war of epic proportions!

Left for dead after a battle, Luca is saved by the mysterious Pontiff and learns he is not the only person with unusual powers. The Pontiff has formed a special team of Branch-hexed individuals he plans to use to help him defeat rival empires, and Luca learns that his powers, rather than being an escape from the battlefield, now force him to be a muse of massacre.
description.fr:
Transcender le fracas des armes, décider du sort de la bataille !
Luka, orphelin recueilli par le chef d'un groupe de mercenaires, n'est pas comme les autres : une branche pousse sur son crâne et il peut voir les sons, matérialisés par des traits de lumière... Le seul à lui parler sans crainte est son père adoptif, aussi fin stratège qu'impitoyable au combat. À 14 ans, Luka a déjà vu assez d'horreurs pour une vie. En tant que clairon, il est de tous les affrontements, transmettant les ordres via son instrument. En réalité, il n'a qu'une envie : échapper à ce quotidien fait de violence pour devenir musicien...


Seulement, la bataille qui s'annonce pourrait être sa dernière : cette fois, il doit prendre les armes... et, surtout, parmi ses opposants se trouvent d'autres "branchus' dotés de divers pouvoirs surnaturels ! Ils font un massacre dans les rangs de Luka, et ce dernier, blessé, se saisit d'un clairon pour sonner la retraite... C'est alors que son véritable pouvoir se dévoile : tous ses alliés visualisent le son de son instrument et ses indications résonnent comme des ordres dans la tête des soldats de son camp ! Le garçon les sauve grâce aux stratégies de son père adoptif.


Témoins de son exploit, les énigmatiques adversaires s'emparent de lui. Luka s'éveille dans une ville entourant une tour immense, vestige des temps anciens et source de magie... Ses nouveaux compagnons sont les protecteurs du lieu, régi par un mystérieux pape. Celui-ci passe un accord avec Luka : si le garçon met son pouvoir et son don tactique à son service, il l'aidera à devenir musicien. Sans le savoir, le jeune prodige se retrouve embarqué dans une guerre dont les enjeux le dépassent !


La lumière du son, seul espoir dans l'horreur des batailles... D'un trait vif et nerveux, une nouvelle génération d'auteurs invente un monde de dark fantasy sans concession. Mais ici, pas de héros surdoué au combat, juste un garçon rêvant de musique... Et pourtant, de ses talents dépend l'issue du conflit !

description.en:
"You realize that these aren't just obligatory chocolates, right?"

Obligatory chocolate is the kind that you give to people you don't even like, just because it's a Valentine's Day tradition. Aya, a beautiful office lady who is often misunderstood because of her lack of visible emotions, was complaining about it to her boss Takaki, as they walked to the train station together after work. However, Takaki told her, "That's too bad, because I was really looking forward to getting chocolates from Aya, even if it's just obligatory…"

As they parted ways, Aya hands Takaki a box of chocolates. Takaki is confused, because he thought she didn't like giving out obligatory chocolates…

"Senpai, are you really that dumb?"

Winner of the 3rd Toaru Nichijou Manga Award, it's a sweet romantic comedy that will satisfy your heart and your sweet tooth!
description.pt-br:
Você percebe que estes não são apenas chocolates obrigatórios, certo?

Aya, uma bela moça de escritório que costuma ser mal interpretada por causa de sua falta de emoções visíveis, estava reclamando disso com seu chefe Takaki, enquanto caminhavam juntos para a estação de trem depois do trabalho. No entanto, Takaki disse a ela: 

"Isso é uma pena, porque eu realmente estava ansioso para ganhar chocolates de Aya, mesmo que seja apenas obrigatório..."

Ao se despedirem, Aya entrega uma caixa de chocolates a Takaki. Takaki fica confuso, porque pensou que ela não gostava de dar chocolates obrigatórios...

"Senpai, você é realmente tão burro?"

description.en:
College student Sota Akizuki is swept overboard during a violent storm and believes his life is over. When he awakens, he finds himself stranded on a mysterious island in another world.

There, he learns that men are extraordinarily rare—only one is born for every thousand people. Because of this imbalance, the Kingdom and the Empire wage endless wars over men. In this strange world, men avoid women while women desperately seek them, creating a deeply distorted social order.

Trying to conceal his true circumstances, Sota acts as he normally would, only to discover that his very "normality" is what makes him extraordinary. In a world where a man's sexual desire itself is treated as an overwhelming advantage, he begins captivating one strong and beautiful woman after another.

島を彷徨う中で出会ったのは、異様な装いの美女・フィリス。
彼女を介抱した颯太は、この場所が異世界である事実に気がつく。
この世界で男は千人に一人しか生まれない希少な存在。
そのため『王国』と『帝国』は男を奪い合い、絶えず戦火を交えているという。
男は女を遠ざけ、女は男を渇望する――歪な均衡が支配する世界。
事情を隠しつつも自然に振る舞う颯太だったが、
その"普通"こそが、この世界で異質だったようで…？

Then she encounters a man who has nothing but ulterior motives, whose thoughts and feelings were completely straightforward?! As she is thrown about by his completely unfiltered thoughts, Kokoro experiences for the first time the sense of security that comes from knowing there are no lies, and little by little, begins to open her heart.

C’est alors qu’elle rencontre un homme qui n’a que des arrière-pensées, mais dont les pensées et les sentiments sont d’une franchise absolue ?! Ballottée par ses pensées sans filtre, Kokoro éprouve pour la première fois ce sentiment de sécurité que procure l’absence de mensonges et, petit à petit, commence à ouvrir son cœur.

Постепенно он узнаёт, что её положение в академии оказалось непростым, и решает вмешаться. Неожиданная встреча приводит к судьбоносному повороту, и вскоре она делает ему необычное предложение: «Позволь мне остаться у тебя...»

Так начинается их новая, полная тайн и испытаний совместная жизнь.

Это школьная романтическая история о выборе, дружбе и втором шансе.

biography.en:
Himura Kiseki (比村奇石) is a mangaka who previously worked on the manga adaptation of Sword Art Online: Progressive. He also did the character designs for the anime Just Because!

Of course, he’s not as well known for that. Instead many know him more for Tawawa On Mondays, a Twitter webcomic. Primarily featuring women with large… tawawas, he releases a new page every Monday to help lighten the moods of people going to work that week. Aside from compiling the pages of those into regular doujins, he also draws it as a semi-regular manga series. 

His doujinshi circle is [Himura Nyuugyou](https://mangadex.org/author/2374142a-b07e-4e98-99eb-31bec75321b5) (比村乳業).

description.en:
After a life seemingly devoid of meaning, a man reincarnates in a new world as Yuri Ho. 

Immersed in novel experiences and embraced by parents who shower him with unprecedented affection, his will to live grows like never before. The future that lies before him is a peaceful existence on his father's ranch, breeding and raising birds to be ridden by warriors fighting distant wars. His new home, the Shiyalta Kingdom, has enjoyed peace and prosperity for centuries, shielded by friendly nations that, like Shiyalta itself, were established following the collapse of a once-great empire. It seems no threat can compromise this idyllic lifestyle. 

However, when the effects of a neighboring kingdom's war throw Yuri's family into crisis, he finds himself unable to stand by and watch.
description.ja:
世間から見放され死んだ男は、異なる世界で新たな生を受ける。

「この人たちと生きたい…この世界で！！」

しかし“異種族”の侵略により世界は激変。戦火が徐々に迫ってくる中、騎士の名門ホウ家の当主だったユーリの伯父の戦死が契機となり、彼と家族は騎士の世界――“戦乱”へと呼び戻されてしまうのだった……。

Проте з початком вторгнення іншої раси, полум'я війни насувається на нього та його родину. І для того, щоб захистити своїх близьких, Юрі змушений кинутися до низки нескінченних битв. Чи впорається він?! Тут починається історія про переможний шлях людини, чиє ім'я пізніше прогримить на весь світ.
description.pt-br:
Depois de uma vida aparentemente sem sentido, um homem renasce em um novo mundo como Yuri Ho.

Cercado por novas experiências e acolhido por pais que o envolvem com um amor que ele jamais conhecera, a vontade de Yuri de viver começa a florescer. Seu futuro parece tranquilo — cuidar do rancho do pai, criando e treinando aves usadas como montarias por guerreiros que lutam em terras distantes.

Sua nova pátria, o Reino de Shiyalta, desfruta de longa paz e prosperidade, protegida por nações vizinhas amigas que, assim como Shiyalta, foram fundadas após a queda de um império outrora grandioso. Nada parece capaz de perturbar essa existência serena.

No entanto, quando os efeitos da guerra em um reino vizinho atravessam a fronteira e lançam sua família em uma crise, Yuri percebe que não pode simplesmente ficar parado e assistir.

İnsanların terk ettiği bir tema parkı olan Granbell Krallığı'nda artık robotlar yaşamaktadır. Robotların yanı sıra onlarla birlikte yaşamını sürdüren tek bir insan vardır: Shiki.  [**Rave Master**](https://mangadex.org/title/5923081c-ad82-4a8b-a509-89ebe752db01) ve [**Fairy Tail**](https://mangadex.org/title/227e3f72-863f-46f9-bafe-c43104ca29ee) ile tanınan Hiro Mashima'nın yeni serisi.

biography.en:
**Name In Native Language:** 真島ヒロ

**Birthdate:** May 3, 1977

Mashima Hiro first gained success with *Rave Master*, serialized in Koudansha's *Weekly Shounen Magazine* from 1999 to 2005. His best-selling work, *Fairy Tail*, published in the same magazine from 2006 to 2017, became one of the best-selling manga series ever with over 72 million copies in print. Mashima began the currently ongoing *EDENS ZERO* in 2018.

Mashima is known for many things, but his big three tend to be an artstyle reminiscent of *One Piece*, a love for the power of friendship, and a strong work ethic - at one point, he wrote six chapters of *Fairy Tail* in two weeks, and even recently simultaneously balanced drawing *EDENS ZERO*, doing storyboards for *Fairy Tail* spinoffs, and playing video games in his spare time.

Tras dejar su trabajo como aventurero, Aix anuncia que no trabajará más. La gente que había estado disfrutando de los beneficios de la magia de novato de duración inusual de Aix, entró en pánico cuando se dio cuenta de que no había nadie para reemplazarlo, pero era demasiado tarde. biography.en:
Gosho Aoyama (Japanese: 青山 剛昌, Hepburn: Aoyama Gōshō, born June 21, 1963) is a Japanese manga artist best known for his manga series Detective Conan (1994–present), known as Case Closed in some English-speaking countries. As of 2017, his various manga series had a combined 200 million copies in print worldwide.

Aoyama made his debut as a manga artist with *Chotto Mattete*, which was published in the magazine Weekly Shōnen Sunday in winter of 1987. Shortly after that, he began *Magic Kaito* in the same magazine. *Magic Kaito* protagonist Kaito Kuroba later appeared in Case Closed.

Between 1988 and 1993, Aoyama created the series *Yaiba*, which ran for 24 volumes. Later, he would release other manga series in single volumes, such as Third Baseman No.4 and Gosho Aoyama's Collection of Short Stories.

Aoyama began serializing *Detective Conan* in Weekly Shōnen Sunday on January 19, 1994. When the series was first released in English, it was given the title Case Closed.

description.en:
Kureha Sara is the reigning "Super Onee-sama" of an elite ladies' academy, a position she's earned through nothing but relentless effort. Her status is suddenly challenged by Mareshino Rui, an effortlessly perfect beauty who proposes a secret contest to determine who is truly fit to get on top. With the school-wide popularity poll just two months away, they need a way to settle the score, just the two of them. Rui's method is... quite unexpected.

"So, that's why... you're going to be my girlfriend."
"Huh...?"

The rules of their new relationship are simple: the first one to make the other completely submit proves she is worthy of ruling the school! And so begins a secret war of seduction, with each girl launching an all-out offensive to make the other fall for them first. In this heated battle, whose heart—and body—will be the first to surrender? And who will be the one to conquer them?

description.pt-br:
Kureha Sara é a atual "Super Onee-sama" de uma academia de elite para moças, um status que ela conquistou unicamente através de um esforço implacável. Sua posição é subitamente desafiada por Mareshino Rui, uma beldade de perfeição natural, que propõe uma competição secreta para determinar quem é verdadeiramente digna de estar no topo.
_______________
Faltando apenas dois meses para a pesquisa de popularidade da escola, elas precisam de uma forma de resolver a disputa, apenas entre elas. O método de Rui é... bastante inesperado.
_______________
> ㅤ
«Então, é por isso que... você vai ser minha namorada.»
«Hã...?»
--------------------
As regras de seu novo relacionamento são simples: a primeira que fizer a outra se submeter completamente provará que é digna de governar a escola! E assim começa uma guerra secreta de sedução, com cada garota lançando uma ofensiva total para fazer a outra se apaixonar primeiro.
_______________
Nesta batalha acirrada, qual coração — e corpo — será o primeiro a se render? E quem será aquela que irá conquistá-los? Prepare-se para ser dominado(a) por este confronto de comédia romântica entre duas lindas garotas

Tuy nhiên, vì Karen là một họa sĩ manga vô cùng bận rộn nên từ lúc cưới đến nay, đôi vợ chồng son hầu như vẫn chưa có khoảnh khắc nào "đúng nghĩa vợ chồng". Để làm điều gì đó sao cho thật dáng dấp của một “vợ chồng”, Jouji liền nảy ra một ý tưởng… là đi hưởng tuần trăng mật!!!

Họ quyết định quay lại nơi bắt đầu tình yêu, nơi hai người đã từng tình cờ gặp nhau là từ việc thông qua những chuyến hành trình và lần này điểm đến tình yêu của họ đó chính là: đảo Niijima!

Cùng xách balo lên và đi, rong ruổi khắp mọi nẻo đường cùng cô vợ dễ thương thôi nào ♪
Chuyến đi hưởng tuần trăng mật ngập tràn tiếng cười và vị ngọt tình yêu của đôi vợ chồng mới cưới chính thức bắt đầu!!!!

The Demon King was defeated. The world was at peace. And so Adventurers were losing their jobs.
And though Theodore was the backbone of the Hero’s party, and worked as a choreman who would take any jobs, he was not immune to this change.

“I have enough money, so maybe I’ll just live a slow life in the countryside.”

Theodore thought. But then his old friend the guild master said,
‘Could you join the investigation in the new continent?’ It was a request.

If people needed his help, then joining would not be a bad thing.
And so Theodore decided to go to the new continent.

“Kyao?”
On the way to the new continent, Theodore tamed a large, and strangely shaped young dragon.
And with this dragon, he heads to the new continent.

With his ‘Appraisal’ skill he is able to see the quality of the soil in an instant, the ‘Crafting’ skill allows him to create a mansion all at once, and the ‘Taming’ skill can even tame a dragon.
With these cheat-level skills, Theodore’s comfortable slow life on the frontiers begins!

description.en:
A collection of stories depicting close bonds between girls, especially heroine × villainess, both romantic and platonic, which were published on *Shousetsuka ni Narou*!
+++**Volume 1 Contents:**
**Cover:** Maro
1. (*Has GL ending.*) **The Heroine's Capture Target Is…** (ヒロインの攻略対象は……), Art by Kawano Akiko, Story by yui/south², [Original Web Novel](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n8335ef/).
The villainess' engagement is broken at an evening party. Called by the prince, what will the heroine do…?!
2. (***NO** GL ending.*) **Milady Looked Extremely Troubled When Her Engagement Was Broken, so I Stepped in to Help Her** (婚約破棄されたお嬢様が大変そうなので助けに入りました), Art by Ooba Soto, Story by Ringoame Tsuin, [Original Web Novel](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n9459fo/).
The lady she served had her engagement broken before her very eyes?!
3.  (***NO** GL ending.*) **My Best Friend's Engagement Was Broken. I Need to Do My Best to Stop It! …But I Was the Reason Behind It…** (婚約破棄されました。私の親友が!必ず阻止します!……私が原因なのでorz), Art by Wani, Story by naturalsoft, [Original Web Novel](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n3379dw/).
I thought I could avoid the condemnation scene after becoming friends with the villainess, but…?!
4. (***NO** GL ending.*) **My Friendship Route With the Villainess** (悪役令嬢との友情ルート), Art by Hoshina, Story by Taikoban, [Original Web Novel](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n9052ee/).
The reincarnated heroine aims to save the villainess?! Using knowledge from the original work, she becomes acquainted with the villainess…
5. (***NO** GL ending.*) **The “Villain”ess's Engagement Braking, or an Account of the ⟨Dark Saint⟩ ~another story~** (“悪役"令嬢の婚約破棄、もしくは〈黒の聖女〉顛末記~another story~), Art by Shidou Murasaki, Story by Fujiyama, [Original Web Novel](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n7544cy/).
 All of the villainess' actions are for the sake of the heroine…
+++
+++**Volume 2 Contents:**
**Cover:** Maro
1. (*Has GL ending.*) **The Villainess Receives a Pledge of Love From an Adorable, Beautiful Rival** (悪役令嬢は天使のようなライバル美少女に愛を誓われる). By Michiyuki Aoi.
2. (*Has GL ending.*) **Since I Was Reincarnated as the Villainess, I Wanted to Be Kind to the Heroine to Avoid Being Banished From the Country, but She Is So Slow, Clumsy, and Dumb That I Had to Play the Straight Man and Be Strict With Her, Which — Sure Enough — Resulted in My Fiancé, the Prince, Condemning Me at the Graduation Party** (悪役令嬢に転生したので、国外追放回避の為ヒロインに優しく接したいが、ヒロインが鈍臭くてボケボケなので厳しく接してツッコミまくっていたら、案の定卒業パーティーで婚約者である王子から断罪されている最中です). Art by Kashii Aoi, Story by Mon-chan. [Original Web Novel](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n6610gi/).
3. (*Has GL ending.*) **Even If You Say, 'I Will Never Love You,' There Was No Need to Do So in the First Place** (「愛することはない」と言われましても、そもそもその必要はございません。). Art by Manatamayumu, Story by Iwashi Dukushi. [Original Web Novel](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n2695hy/).
4. (*Has GL ending.*) **A Commoner Like Me Got Tangled up With a Haughty Villainess, What Should I Do?** (平民の私が高慢な悪役令嬢に絡まれているのですが、どうすればいいですか？). Art by Hoshina, Story by Ringoame Tsuin. [Original Web Novel](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n2667gs/).
5. (**GL ending.*) **As I Am to Become a Monarch, I Will Decline This Marriage Proposal. My Lovely Little Sister Is Waiting for Me** (わたくしこそが王となりますゆえ、此度の縁談はお断りさせていただきますわ。かわいい妹が待っておりますの). Art by Fuyume Saya, Story by Nakamura Syuri. [Original Web Novel](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n1179hz/).
+++
+++**Volume 3 Contents:**
**Cover:** Maro
1. 王子に婚約破棄された令嬢が、王妃に返り咲くまで. Art by Nibi (にび), Story by Pomekawa Yui. [Original Web Novel](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n9315id/)
2. 光の魔法菓子と婚約破棄～少女の魔法菓子が令嬢を魅了する～. By Mugicha Poyoko.
3. 悪女の秘密のお仕事. By Natsuno Nae.
4. 性悪の私と婚約破棄して、聖女の義妹と結婚ですか？　殿下、それはおやめになった方がよろしいかと. Art by Kuro Komari, Story by Kitayuki Mai. [Original Web Novel](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n6511ib/)
5. シンデレラが可愛すぎるので私が幸せにしてみせます！ By Kuriyama Kogane and Otsu Hiyori.
+++

description.en:
"If my guy friend turned into a girl, he would be the perfect girlfriend!"
Returning to his hometown after 10 years, Amano Koichi is thrilled to finally reunite with his childhood friend, Yukio Sawatari on the first day of school when suddenly, he turns female! 
Yukio is affected by "Sudden sex change syndrome", a rare condition present in one every ten thousand people which randomly changes their gender!
Koichi can't help but be flustered by his childhood friend's cuteness.
How will this complicate their relationship?
Will it develop into a forbidden romance?!
Find out in this exciting TSF Rom-com!
description.id:
Amano, yang kembali ke kota tempat dia tinggal sewaktu kecil untuk pertama kalinya setelah 10 tahun, bertemu Yukio Sawatari, seorang teman masa kecil di hari pertama pemindahan, ketika dia (seorang teman pria) menjadi wanita! Meskipun dia berbagi suka citanya, saat dia tiba-tiba berubah menjadi seorang gadis dan tidak bisa menyembunyikan rasa malunya. Yukio terkena penyakit seperti 100.000 orang lainnya, tiba-tiba menjadi seorang gadis yang disebut "spontaneous isomerism metamorphosis"!  
  
Teman masa kecil perempuan ♂ yang imut dan dalam kesulitan!? Cinta TSF (transeksual) Terlarang!  
  
Kalo gak paham baca ajalah, ada sinopsis juga gak guna.

description.en:
Atago Gato is a shy and reclusive high school boy. One day, while preparing for the school festival, a cute and cheerful classmate named Shimizu Roman finds out that he is aiming to become a manga artist. Isn't that amazing? The popular girl, who seems to live in a different world from him, takes an interest in him and asks him a lot of questions he never expected! When he confesses a traumatic experience after being criticized on SNS... Shimizu-san tries to help him overcome it in a slightly strange way...?

(Source: AniList)
description.es: Atago Gato es un chico de instituto tímido y solitario. Un día, mientras se prepara para el festival escolar, una simpática y alegre compañera de clase llamada Shimizu Roman descubre que aspira a convertirse en dibujante de manga. ¿No es increíble? La chica popular, que parece vivir en un mundo distinto al suyo, se interesa por él y le hace un montón de preguntas que no esperaba. Cuando confiesa una experiencia traumática tras ser criticado en SNS... Shimizu-san intenta ayudarle a superarlo de una forma un tanto extraña...? ¡Una comedia romántica juvenil en la que una chica alegre y un chico sombrío luchan por hacer manga!
description.id:
Atago Gato adalah anak SMA yang pemalu dan tertutup. Suatu hari, saat mempersiapkan festival sekolah, teman sekelasnya yang lucu dan ceria bernama Shimizu Roman mengetahui bahwa dia bercita-cita menjadi seorang seniman manga. Bukankah itu luar biasa? Gadis populer, yang sepertinya hidup di dunia yang berbeda darinya, menaruh minat padanya dan menanyakan banyak pertanyaan yang tidak pernah dia duga! Saat dia mengakui pengalaman traumatis setelah dikritik di SNS... Shimizu-san mencoba membantunya mengatasinya dengan cara yang sedikit aneh...?
Sebuah komedi romantis masa muda di mana seorang gadis ceria dan seorang anak laki-laki muram berjuang untuk membuat manga!

description.es-la: Atago Gato es un chico de instituto tímido y solitario. Un día, mientras se prepara para el festival escolar, una simpática y alegre compañera de clase llamada Shimizu Roman descubre que aspira a convertirse en dibujante de manga. ¿No es increíble? La chica popular, que parece vivir en un mundo distinto al suyo, se interesa por él y le hace un montón de preguntas que no esperaba. Cuando confiesa una experiencia traumática tras ser criticado en SNS... Shimizu-san intenta ayudarle a superarlo de una forma un tanto extraña...? ¡Una comedia romántica juvenil en la que una chica alegre y un chico sombrío luchan por hacer manga!
